def evaluate(evidence, spec, workspace, samples):
    failures = []
    if evidence.get("core_source_errors"):
        failures.append("invalid_core_source_provenance")
    expected = 2 if spec["mode"] == "parallel" else 1
    workers = evidence["workers"]
    attempts = evidence["attempts"]
    passes = independent_passes(evidence, spec["provider_id"], spec["model_id"])
    unknown = [
        item["attempt_id"]
        for item in attempts
        if item["input_charged"] is None or item["output_charged"] is None
    ]
    known_tokens = sum(
        (item["input_charged"] or 0) + (item["output_charged"] or 0)
        for item in attempts
    )
    if len(evidence["quests"]) != 1 or evidence["quests"][0]["status"] != "completed":
        failures.append("one_completed_quest_required")
    if evidence["conversation_count"] != 1 or len(evidence["router"]) != 1:
        failures.append("one_persistent_router_conversation_required")
    if len(workers) != expected or len(passes) != expected:
        failures.append("independently_verified_worker_count_mismatch")
    if unknown or any(item["state"] != "settled" for item in attempts):
        failures.append("model_usage_unresolved_or_unknown")
    if known_tokens > spec["limits"]["max_total_tokens"]:
        failures.append("original_token_cap_exceeded")
    if not evidence["router_completion_notice"]:
        failures.append("router_completion_notice_missing")
    if len(evidence["immutability_triggers"]) != 4:
        failures.append("immutable_action_triggers_missing")
    input_checks = []
    for item in spec["inputs"]:
        path = Path(workspace) / item["path"]
        valid = path.is_file() and sha(path.read_bytes()) == item["sha256"]
        input_checks.append({"path": item["path"], "unchanged": valid})
        if not valid:
            failures.append("original_input_changed:" + item["path"])
    receipt_failures = [
        {"intent_id": action["intent_id"], "errors": receipt_errors(action)}
        for action in evidence["actions"]
        if receipt_errors(action)
    ]
    if receipt_failures:
        failures.append("invalid_or_unresolved_action_receipts")
    if any(
        worker["execution_mode"] != "live"
        or worker["provider_id"] != spec["provider_id"]
        or worker["model_id"] != spec["model_id"]
        or worker["steps"] > spec["limits"]["max_worker_steps"]
        or worker["tool_spent"] > spec["limits"]["max_worker_tool_calls"]
        or worker["repairs"] > 2
        or worker["token_spent"] > worker["token_limit"]
        for worker in workers
    ):
        failures.append("worker_mode_or_original_limits_violated")
    if spec["mode"] == "parallel":
        goal = parallel_check(
            evidence, samples, passes, spec["provider_id"], spec["model_id"]
        )
    elif spec["mode"] == "review-revision":
        goal = review_revision_check(
            evidence, passes, spec["provider_id"], spec["model_id"]
        )
    else:
        goal = controlled_defect_check(evidence, spec, workspace)
    if not goal["passed"]:
        failures.append(goal["reason"])
    return {
        "passed": not failures,
        "failures": failures,
        "independent_passes": passes,
        "goal_evidence": goal,
        "input_checks": input_checks,
        "receipt_failures": receipt_failures,
        "usage": {"known_total_tokens": known_tokens, "unknown_attempt_ids": unknown},
        "identity_limit": "Configured proxy/model identity; physical upstream identity is unverified.",
        "parallel_limit": "Overlapping Gateway admission windows, not physical upstream scheduling.",
    }


def review_revision_check(evidence, passes, provider, model):
    """Require actual model revision, resumed work and a later fresh PASS."""
    events = evidence["events"]
    for event in events:
        review = event["payload"]
        run_id = review.get("run_id")
        if not (
            event["event_type"] == "review.result"
            and review.get("verdict") == "NEEDS_REVISION"
            and review.get("review_context") == "independent_same_model"
            and review.get("execution_mode") == "live"
            and review.get("provider_id") == provider
            and review.get("model_id") == model
            and review.get("revision_goals")
            and run_id in passes
            and len(str(review.get("packet_sha256", ""))) == 64
        ):
            continue
        final = passes[run_id]
        actual = any(
            a["call_id"] == review.get("call_id")
            and a["worker_run_id"] == run_id
            and a["purpose"] == "independent_reviewer"
            and a["provider_id"] == provider
            and a["model_id"] == model
            and known_settled(a)
            for a in evidence["attempts"]
        )
        started = any(
            e["event_type"] == "review.started"
            and e["payload"].get("call_id") == review.get("call_id")
            and e["payload"].get("result_event_id") == review.get("result_event_id")
            and e["payload"].get("packet_sha256") == review.get("packet_sha256")
            and e["seq"] < event["seq"]
            for e in events
        )
        for request in events:
            if not (
                request["event_type"] == "worker.revision_requested"
                and request["payload"].get("run_id") == run_id
                and request["payload"].get("review_event_id") == event["id"]
                and request["payload"].get("revision_goals") == review["revision_goals"]
                and request["seq"] > event["seq"]
            ):
                continue
            corrected = any(
                e["event_type"] == "worker.result"
                and e["id"] == final["result_event_id"]
                and e["payload"].get("run_id") == run_id
                and e["seq"] > request["seq"]
                and e["id"] != review.get("result_event_id")
                for e in events
            )
            if (
                actual
                and started
                and corrected
                and final["call_id"] != review.get("call_id")
            ):
                return {
                    "passed": True,
                    "run_id": run_id,
                    "needs_revision_event_id": event["id"],
                    "initial_result_event_id": review["result_event_id"],
                    "revision_request_event_id": request["id"],
                    "final_result_event_id": final["result_event_id"],
                    "pass_review_event_id": final["review_event_id"],
                    "method": "Disclosed incomplete draft; both verdicts are actual model outputs.",
                }
    return {
        "passed": False,
        "reason": "actual_model_revision_then_fresh_pass_not_observed",
    }

import hashlib
import json
import sqlite3
import time
from contextlib import contextmanager
from pathlib import Path


def sha(data):
    return hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()


def canonical(value):
    return json.dumps(
        value,
        sort_keys=True,
        separators=(",", ":"),
        ensure_ascii=False,
        allow_nan=False,
    )


@contextmanager
def readonly(workspace):
    database = Path(workspace) / "data" / "forge.sqlite3"
    connection = sqlite3.connect(
        database.resolve().as_uri() + "?mode=ro", uri=True, timeout=1
    )
    connection.row_factory = sqlite3.Row
    try:
        connection.execute("PRAGMA query_only=ON")
        connection.execute("BEGIN")
        yield connection
        if connection.total_changes:
            raise RuntimeError("Audit connection unexpectedly changed data")
    finally:
        connection.close()


def reservation_sample(workspace, quest_id):
    """Observe actual admitted Worker attempts, excluding independent review calls."""
    with readonly(workspace) as connection:
        rows = connection.execute(
            "SELECT a.attempt_id,a.call_id,a.worker_run_id,a.provider_id,a.model_id,"
            "a.created_at,a.recover_after,w.worker_id,w.node_key,w.state AS worker_state,"
            "w.lease_until,c.next_action FROM model_budget_attempts a "
            "JOIN worker_runs w ON w.id=a.worker_run_id "
            "JOIN worker_capsules c ON c.run_id=w.id "
            "WHERE a.quest_id=? AND a.purpose='worker' AND a.state='reserved' "
            "AND w.execution_mode='live' AND w.state='running' AND c.next_action='model' "
            "AND w.lease_until>? ORDER BY a.attempt_id",
            (quest_id, time.time()),
        ).fetchall()
        return {"observed_at": time.time(), "attempts": [dict(row) for row in rows]}


def collect(workspace, quest_id):
    with readonly(workspace) as connection:

        def rows(sql, parameters=()):
            return [dict(row) for row in connection.execute(sql, parameters)]

        result = {
            "quests": rows("SELECT id,status,version,plan_revision FROM quests"),
            "workers": rows(
                "SELECT id,worker_id,quest_id,plan_id,node_key,plan_revision,plan_digest,"
                "team_digest,member_index,role_id,provider_id,model_id,execution_mode,state,"
                "token_limit,token_spent,tool_limit,tool_spent,step_limit,steps,repairs,depth,"
                "deadline FROM worker_runs WHERE quest_id=? ORDER BY created_at,id",
                (quest_id,),
            ),
            "attempts": rows(
                "SELECT attempt_id,call_id,purpose,quest_id,worker_run_id,provider_id,model_id,"
                "state,created_at,recover_after,input_reserved,output_reserved,input_charged,"
                "output_charged,cost_charged,currency FROM model_budget_attempts "
                "ORDER BY created_at,attempt_id"
            ),
            "actions": rows(
                "SELECT i.rowid AS ordinal,i.id AS intent_id,i.call_id,i.run_id,i.worker_id,"
                "i.plan_id,i.plan_revision,i.tool_name,i.parameters_json,i.parameter_digest,"
                "i.resource_scope,i.execution_mode AS intent_mode,i.state AS intent_state,"
                "r.id AS receipt_id,r.execution_mode AS receipt_mode,r.result_json,"
                "r.result_digest,c.model_call_id,c.state AS call_state,c.arguments_json,"
                "c.result_json AS call_result_json FROM action_intents i "
                "LEFT JOIN action_receipts r ON r.intent_id=i.id "
                "LEFT JOIN worker_tool_calls c ON c.run_id=i.run_id AND c.call_id=i.call_id "
                "WHERE i.quest_id=? ORDER BY i.rowid",
                (quest_id,),
            ),
            "events": rows(
                "SELECT id,seq,event_type,worker_id,payload FROM events WHERE quest_id=? "
                "ORDER BY seq",
                (quest_id,),
            ),
            "nodes": rows(
                "SELECT n.plan_id,n.node_key,n.worker_id,n.status FROM task_nodes n "
                "JOIN quest_plans p ON p.id=n.plan_id WHERE p.quest_id=?",
                (quest_id,),
            ),
            "verification": rows(
                "SELECT v.plan_id,v.node_key,v.worker_id,v.state,v.attempts,v.error_code "
                "FROM node_verification_attempts v JOIN quest_plans p ON p.id=v.plan_id "
                "WHERE p.quest_id=?",
                (quest_id,),
            ),
            "immutability_triggers": rows(
                "SELECT name,sql FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='trigger' "
                "AND name IN ('action_intents_immutable_binding','action_intents_immutable_delete',"
                "'action_receipts_immutable_update','action_receipts_immutable_delete') ORDER BY name"
            ),
            "router": rows(
                "SELECT conversation_id,router_session_id FROM router_state"
            ),
            "conversation_count": connection.execute(
                "SELECT count(*) FROM conversations"
            ).fetchone()[0],
            "router_completion_notice": bool(
                connection.execute(
                    "SELECT 1 FROM messages m JOIN events e "
                    "ON e.id=json_extract(m.metadata,'$.event_id') WHERE m.role='assistant' "
                    "AND json_extract(m.metadata,'$.source')='router_notice' AND e.quest_id=? "
                    "AND e.event_type='quest.status_changed' "
                    "AND json_extract(e.payload,'$.to')='completed' LIMIT 1",
                    (quest_id,),
                ).fetchone()
            ),
            "read_only_changes": connection.total_changes,
        }
        from acceptance_checks import _ReadOnlyStore
        from forge_core.domain import DomainError
        from forge_core.settings import Workspace
        from forge_core.worker_prefetch import verified_sources

        store = _ReadOnlyStore(Path(workspace).resolve())
        identity = connection.execute(
            "SELECT id FROM workspace WHERE singleton=1"
        ).fetchone()
        store.workspace = Workspace.from_path(workspace, identity[0])
        result["core_source_errors"] = []
        prefetched = {}
        for worker in result["workers"]:
            full_run = connection.execute(
                "SELECT * FROM worker_runs WHERE id=?", (worker["id"],)
            ).fetchone()
            try:
                entries = verified_sources(store, connection, full_run, historical=True)
                for entry in entries:
                    prefetched[entry["call_id"]] = entry
            except (DomainError, KeyError, TypeError, ValueError, sqlite3.Error) as exc:
                result["core_source_errors"].append(
                    {"run_id": worker["id"], "error": type(exc).__name__}
                )
        result["verified_core_sources"] = list(prefetched.values())
        for action in result["actions"]:
            if action["call_id"] in prefetched:
                action["source_origin"] = "core_prefetch"
                action["core_source_entry"] = prefetched[action["call_id"]]
            else:
                action["source_origin"] = "model"
    for event in result["events"]:
        event["payload"] = json.loads(event["payload"])
    return result


def receipt_errors(action):
    errors = []
    if action["intent_mode"] != "live" or action["receipt_mode"] != "live":
        errors.append("receipt_not_live")
    try:
        parameters = json.loads(action["parameters_json"])
        output = json.loads(action["result_json"])
        if sha(canonical(parameters).encode()) != action["parameter_digest"]:
            errors.append("parameter_digest_mismatch")
        if sha(action["result_json"].encode()) != action["result_digest"]:
            errors.append("result_digest_mismatch")
        if action.get("source_origin") == "core_prefetch":
            entry = action["core_source_entry"]
            if (
                action["model_call_id"] is not None
                or action["tool_name"] != "file_read"
                or action["intent_state"] != "succeeded"
                or entry["call_id"] != action["call_id"]
                or entry["receipt_id"] != action["receipt_id"]
                or entry["arguments"] != parameters
                or entry["output"] != output
                or entry["result_sha256"] != action["result_digest"]
            ):
                errors.append("core_source_receipt_binding_mismatch")
        else:
            wrapper = json.loads(action["call_result_json"])
            if json.loads(action["arguments_json"]) != parameters:
                errors.append("worker_argument_binding_mismatch")
            if (
                wrapper.get("receipt_id") != action["receipt_id"]
                or wrapper.get("output") != output
                or wrapper.get("state") != action["intent_state"]
                or action["call_state"] != action["intent_state"]
            ):
                errors.append("worker_receipt_binding_mismatch")
    except (ValueError, TypeError, AttributeError):
        errors.append("invalid_receipt_json")
    return errors


def independent_passes(evidence, provider, model):
    passed = {}
    for worker in evidence["workers"]:
        results = [
            event
            for event in evidence["events"]
            if event["event_type"] == "worker.result"
            and event["payload"].get("run_id") == worker["id"]
        ]
        if not results:
            continue
        final_result = results[-1]
        for event in evidence["events"]:
            review = event["payload"]
            if not (
                event["event_type"] == "review.result"
                and review.get("run_id") == worker["id"]
                and review.get("result_event_id") == final_result["id"]
                and review.get("verdict") == "PASS"
                and review.get("execution_mode") == "live"
                and review.get("review_context") == "independent_same_model"
                and review.get("provider_id") == provider
                and review.get("model_id") == model
                and len(str(review.get("packet_sha256", ""))) == 64
                and event["seq"] > final_result["seq"]
            ):
                continue
            started = any(
                item["event_type"] == "review.started"
                and item["payload"].get("call_id") == review.get("call_id")
                and item["payload"].get("result_event_id") == final_result["id"]
                and item["payload"].get("packet_sha256") == review.get("packet_sha256")
                for item in evidence["events"]
            )
            actual = any(
                attempt["call_id"] == review.get("call_id")
                and attempt["purpose"] == "independent_reviewer"
                and attempt["worker_run_id"] == worker["id"]
                and attempt["provider_id"] == provider
                and attempt["model_id"] == model
                and known_settled(attempt)
                for attempt in evidence["attempts"]
            )
            verified = any(
                item["plan_id"] == worker["plan_id"]
                and item["node_key"] == worker["node_key"]
                and item["worker_id"] == worker["worker_id"]
                and item["state"] == "verified"
                for item in evidence["verification"]
            )
            if started and actual and verified and worker["state"] == "succeeded":
                passed[worker["id"]] = {
                    "review_event_id": event["id"],
                    "result_event_id": final_result["id"],
                    "call_id": review["call_id"],
                    "packet_sha256": review["packet_sha256"],
                }
    return passed

def receipt_errors(action):
    errors = []

        errors.append("receipt_not_live")
    try:
        parameters = json.loads(action["parameters_json"])
        output = json.loads(action["result_json"])
        if sha(canonical(parameters).encode()) != action["parameter_digest"]:
            errors.append("parameter_digest_mismatch")
        if sha(action["result_json"].encode()) != action["result_digest"]:
            errors.append("result_digest_mismatch")
        if action.get("source_origin") == "core_prefetch":
            entry = action["core_source_entry"]
            if (
                action["model_call_id"] is not None
                or action["tool_name"] != "file_read"
                or action["intent_state"] != "succeeded"
                or entry["call_id"] != action["call_id"]
                or entry["receipt_id"] != action["receipt_id"]
                or entry["arguments"] != parameters
                or entry["output"] != output
                or entry["result_sha256"] != action["result_digest"]
            ):
                errors.append("core_source_receipt_binding_mismatch")
        else:
            wrapper = json.loads(action["call_result_json"])
            if json.loads(action["arguments_json"]) != parameters:
                errors.append("worker_argument_binding_mismatch")
            if (
                wrapper.get("receipt_id") != action["receipt_id"]
                or wrapper.get("output") != output
                or wrapper.get("state") != action["intent_state"]
                or action["call_state"] != action["intent_state"]
            ):
                errors.append("worker_receipt_binding_mismatch")
    except (ValueError, TypeError, AttributeError):
        errors.append("invalid_receipt_json")
    return errors

class WorkerScheduler:
    """Poll durable approvals and checkpoints; no in-memory queue is authoritative."""

    def __init__(self, manager, *, poll_interval=0.05, batch_size=32):
        if type(batch_size) is not int or not 1 <= batch_size <= 256 or poll_interval <= 0:
            raise ValueError("Invalid scheduler bounds")
        self.manager = manager
        self.poll_interval = poll_interval
        self.batch_size = batch_size
        self.tasks = {}
        self.stopping = False
        self.team_cursor = ""
        self.run_cursor = ""
        self.model_usage_cursor = ""
        self.last_failure_code = None

    async def tick(self):
        for run_id, task in list(self.tasks.items()):
            if task.done():
                # Observe failures without exposing provider or tool exception text.
                if not task.cancelled():
                    task.exception()
                del self.tasks[run_id]
        if self.stopping:
            return 0
        manager = self.manager
        from .worker_model_usage import reconcile_worker_model_batch

        # Paused and terminal runs may have settled after the process stopped.
        # Reconcile only their accounting; the normal scheduler owns execution.
        with manager.store.unit_of_work() as work:
            _, usage_cursor = reconcile_worker_model_batch(work.connection, self.model_usage_cursor)

from forge_core.quest_graph import InvalidGraphProposal, QuestGraphService
from forge_core.source_capacity import measure_required_sources


def node(
    key, *, expected=None, inputs=(), predecessors=(), tools=(), kind="delivery_review", bound=32768
):
    return {
        "key": key,
        "objective": "PRIVATE_OBJECTIVE_MARKER must never enter diagnostics",
        "success_criteria": [{"kind": kind}],
        "required_capabilities": [],
        "expected_artifact": expected,
        "max_attempts": 1,
        "allowed_tools": list(tools),
        "verified_input_paths": list(inputs),
        "predecessors": list(predecessors),
        "capacity_bounds": {"max_artifact_bytes": bound, "max_delivery_bytes": bound},
    }


def dependency(key, *, deliveries=None, artifact=True):
    return {
        "node_key": key,
        "condition": "success",
        "read_artifact": artifact,
        "delivery_sources": [key] if deliveries is None else deliveries,
    }


def overflow_wire(*, invalid_kind=True):
    producer = node(
        "producer",
        expected="work/producer.json",
        inputs=["inputs/unicode.json"],
        tools=["file_read", "file_write", "file_revise"],
        kind="json_review",
    )
    consumer = node(
        "consumer",
        predecessors=[dependency("producer")],
        tools=["file_read", "worker_read_completed_delivery"],
        kind="PRIVATE_INVALID_KIND_MARKER" if invalid_kind else "delivery_review",
    )
    second = {**copy.deepcopy(consumer), "key": "second_consumer"}
    return {"allocation_mode": "core_measured", "nodes": [producer, consumer, second]}


def setup(tmp_path):
    store, quest = prepared(
        tmp_path,

        '{"source":"PRIVATE_SOURCE_MARKER"}', encoding="utf-8"
    )

    return store, quest, inventory


def test_invalid_verifier_stays_rejected_while_all_source_overflows_are_measured(tmp_path):
    store, _quest, inventory = setup(tmp_path)

    original = copy.deepcopy(wire)

    with pytest.raises(ValidationError):

    consumer = report["nodes"][1]
    assert consumer["future_contributions"] == [
        {
            "kind": "artifact",
            "producer": "producer",
            "path": "work/producer.json",
            "declared_bound": 32768,
            "bytes": 66048,
        },
        {"kind": "delivery", "producer": "producer", "declared_bound": 32768, "bytes": 34944},
    ]
    assert consumer["future_list_framing_bytes"] == 2
    assert consumer["known_source_bytes"] == 2
    assert consumer["future_source_bytes_bound"] == 100994
    assert consumer["max_source_receipt_bytes"] == 102020
    assert "PRIVATE_" not in json.dumps(report)

    assert wire == original and inventory == before

"""Recorded Router decisions replayed offline through the actual creation path."""

import asyncio
import importlib.util
import json
from pathlib import Path

import pytest
from test_router_intelligence_phase2 import ScriptedMock, router

from forge_core.domain import DomainError, ModelProfile, Quest
from forge_core.providers import ProviderConfig, ProviderGateway
from forge_core.quest_graph import QuestGraphService
from forge_core.settings import Workspace
from forge_core.store import Store


class Captured(Exception):
    pass


class NativeCapture(ProviderGateway):
    """Production framing and no network/model request."""

    def __init__(self, *, repair=False):
        super().__init__(
            ProviderConfig(
                id="p",
                kind="openai_compatible",
                base_url="https://example.invalid/v1",
                credential_ref="FORGE_PROVIDER_KEY_TEST",
                supports_json_schema=True,
            )
        )
        self.requests = []
        self.native_sizes = []
        self.repair = repair

    async def generate(self, request):
        native = self._payload(request, False)
        self.requests.append(request)
        self.native_sizes.append(len(json.dumps(native, ensure_ascii=False).encode()) + 64)
        if self.repair and len(self.requests) == 1:
            return type("InvalidResponse", (), {"text": "{}", "usage": {}})()
        raise Captured


def route_original_scenario(tmp_path, level):
    root = next(
        parent / "backend"
        for parent in Path(__file__).resolve().parents
        if (parent / "backend/scripts/phase2/acceptance_scenarios.py").is_file()
    )
    module_path = root / "scripts/phase2/acceptance_scenarios.py"
    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("planner_v18_scenario", module_path)
    module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
    spec.loader.exec_module(module)
    prompt = module.seed_scenario(level, tmp_path)["prompt"]
    fixture = json.loads(
        (Path(__file__).parent / "fixtures/phase2_router_decisions_v17.json").read_text(
            encoding="utf-8"
        )
    )
    observed = fixture["cases"][level - 1]["decision"]
    store = Store(tmp_path / "core.sqlite3", workspace=Workspace.from_path(tmp_path))
    store.save_model(ModelProfile.model_validate(fixture["model_profile"]))
    result = asyncio.run(
        router(store, ScriptedMock(observed)).handle_user_message(
            prompt, request_id=f"scenario-{level}"
        )
    )
    return store, store.get_quest(result["quest_id"]), prompt, observed


@pytest.mark.parametrize("level", [1, 2, 3])
@pytest.mark.parametrize("repair", [False, True])
def test_actual_router_quest_shape_retains_full_sources_and_fits_native_planner(
    tmp_path, level, repair
):
    store, quest, original, observed = route_original_scenario(tmp_path, level)
    provider = NativeCapture(repair=repair)
    with pytest.raises(Captured):
        asyncio.run(
            QuestGraphService(store).generate(
                quest["id"],
                expected_version=quest["version"],
                provider=provider,
                provider_id="p",
                model_id="native",
                context_limit=65536,
                capabilities={"json_schema": True},
                capability_sources={"json_schema": "test_fixture"},
                require_capacity_contract=True,
            )
        )
    assert len(provider.requests) == (2 if repair else 1)
    data = json.loads(provider.requests[0].messages[1]["content"])
    assert data["original_request"]["content"] == original
    assert data["goal"] == observed["goal"]
    assert data["user_constraints"]["items"]
    assert data["verified_input_inventory"]
    assert (
        data["execution_constraints"]["limits"]["max_total_tokens"]
        == {1: 180000, 2: 360000, 3: 630000}[level]
    )
    for request, native in zip(provider.requests, provider.native_sizes, strict=True):
        assert request.context_limit == 65536
        assert native + request.max_output_tokens <= request.context_limit
        assert request.messages[1]["content"] == provider.requests[0].messages[1]["content"]
    assert QuestGraphService(store).history(quest["id"]) == []

"""Offline V23-wire guidance and diagnostics; no actual-model claims."""

import asyncio
import copy
import json

import pytest
from test_core_measured_serial_v17 import NativeFramingMock
from test_planner_protocol_v23 import graph, node, preview
from test_planner_router_input_v18 import Captured, NativeCapture, route_original_scenario
from test_planner_source_preview_v22 import dependency, setup

from forge_core.planner_guidance_v24 import preview_sources_v23
from forge_core.quest_graph import QuestGraphService


@pytest.mark.parametrize("level", [1, 2, 3])
def test_actual_router_shapes_keep_full_sources_and_guidance_within_original_limits(tmp_path, level):
    store, quest, original, _observed = route_original_scenario(tmp_path, level)
    provider = NativeCapture()
    with pytest.raises(Captured):
        asyncio.run(
            QuestGraphService(store).generate(
                quest["id"],
                expected_version=quest["version"],
                provider=provider,
                provider_id="p",
                model_id="native",
                context_limit=65536,
                capabilities={"json_schema": True},
                capability_sources={"json_schema": "test_fixture"},
                require_capacity_contract=True,
                resource_allocation_mode="core_measured",
                semantic_protocol_version="v23",
            )
        )
    request = provider.requests[0]
    payload = request.messages[1]["content"]
    data = json.loads(payload)
    assert len(payload.encode()) <= 24000
    assert provider.native_sizes[0] + request.max_output_tokens <= 65536
    assert data["original_request"]["content"] == original
    assert data["verified_input_inventory"] and data["verified_input_receipt_sizes"]
    assert data["semantic_protocol_version"] == "v23"
    guidance = data["quantitative_planning_guidance"]
    assert guidance["authority"] == "advice_only_model_selects_all_semantics_and_bounds"
    assert "1536-2048" in guidance["sufficient_starting_points_bytes"]["read_only"]
    assert "action evidence=0" in guidance["sufficient_starting_points_bytes"]["read_only"]
    assert set(guidance["byte_equations"]) >= {"K", "F", "S", "G", "native_correction"}
    assert QuestGraphService(store).history(quest["id"]) == []


def test_v23_source_preview_measures_action_allowance_and_every_handoff_without_mutation(tmp_path):
    store, quest, inventory = setup(tmp_path)
    selected = graph(
        node(
            "producer",
            expected="work/code.py",
            inputs=["inputs/unicode.json"],
            tools=["file_read", "file_write"],
            kind="PRIVATE_INVALID_VERIFIER",
            bound=2048,
            allowance=1024,
        ),
        node(
            "consumer",
            predecessors=[dependency("producer")],
            tools=["file_read", "worker_read_completed_delivery"],
            bound=1536,
            allowance=4096,
        ),
    )
    before = copy.deepcopy(selected)
    report = preview_sources_v23(store, json.dumps(selected), inventory)
    assert report["status"] == "available", report
    first, second = report["nodes"]
    assert first["action_evidence_allowance_bytes"] == 1024
    assert second["future_contributions"] == [
        {"kind": "artifact", "producer": "producer", "path": "work/code.py", "declared_bound": 2048, "bytes": 4608},
        {"kind": "delivery", "producer": "producer", "declared_bound": 2048, "bytes": 4224},
    ]
    assert second["max_source_receipt_bytes"] == 2 + 4608 + 4224 + 2 + 1024 + 4096
    assert report["inventory_owners"] == {"inputs/unicode.json": ["producer"]}
    assert report["unselected_inventory_paths"] == []
    assert "PRIVATE_" not in json.dumps(report)
    assert selected == before and QuestGraphService(store).history(quest.id) == []


def test_complete_preview_explains_all_cycles_and_extra_edge_loss_of_serial_pool(tmp_path):
    store, quest, _inventory = setup(tmp_path)
    selected = graph(
        node("first", inputs=["inputs/unicode.json"], tools=["file_read"], bound=1536),
        node("second", predecessors=[dependency("first", artifact=False)], tools=["worker_read_completed_delivery"], bound=1536),
        node("third", predecessors=[dependency("second", artifact=False)], tools=["worker_read_completed_delivery"], bound=1536),
    )
    original = copy.deepcopy(selected)
    serial = preview(store, quest, selected, NativeFramingMock(selected))
    assert serial["status"] == "available", serial
    aggregate = serial["aggregate_policy_projection"]
    assert aggregate["shape"] == "strict_success_chain"
    assert aggregate["shared_reserve_tokens"] > 0
    assert not aggregate["nodes_with_contract_violations"]
    for observed in serial["nodes"]:
        candidate = observed["candidates"][0]
        assert candidate["minimum_node_tokens"] == candidate["initial_work_tokens"] + candidate["review_cycle_reserve_tokens"]
        assert candidate["policy_cycle_calls"] == 4
        assert candidate["native_correction_headroom"] >= 0
    selected["nodes"][2]["predecessors"].append(dependency("first", artifact=False, deliveries=[]))
    independent = preview(store, quest, selected, NativeFramingMock(selected))
    other = independent["aggregate_policy_projection"]
    assert other["shape"] == "independent_cycles"
    assert other["shared_reserve_tokens"] == 0
    assert other["required_total_projection"] > aggregate["required_total_projection"]
    assert original["nodes"][2]["predecessors"] != selected["nodes"][2]["predecessors"]
    assert QuestGraphService(store).history(quest.id) == []

"""Router consumes actual bounded semantic selections; lexical retrieval remains."""

import asyncio
import json

from test_router_intelligence_phase2 import ScriptedMock, decision

from forge_core.domain import Quest
from forge_core.registry import ModelRegistry, TeamComposer
from forge_core.router import RouterService
from forge_core.runtime import ModelResponse
from forge_core.settings import Workspace
from forge_core.store import Store


class RouterSelector:
    execution_mode = "mock"

    def __init__(self, selected, final=None):
        self.selected, self.final = selected, final or decision()
        self.requests = []

    async def generate(self, request):
        self.requests.append(request)
        if request.budget_context.purpose == "memory_semantic_retrieval":
            candidates = json.loads(request.messages[1]["content"])["candidates"]
            result = {"candidate_ids": [self.selected] if self.selected in candidates else []}
        else:
            result = self.final
        return ModelResponse(text=json.dumps(result), tool_calls=[], usage={}, finish_reason="mock")


def prepared(tmp_path, provider):
    store = Store(tmp_path / "router.sqlite3", workspace=Workspace.from_path(tmp_path))
    router = RouterService(
        store,
        TeamComposer(ModelRegistry(store)),
        provider=provider,
        model_id="explicit-mock",
        context_limit=65536,
        semantic_recall=True,
    )
    return store, router


def test_router_includes_zero_overlap_semantic_memory_with_original_trust(tmp_path):
    provider = RouterSelector("placeholder")
    _, router = prepared(tmp_path, provider)
    identity = router.memory_service.remember(
        "Never disclose passwords or credentials in logs.",
        kind="decision",
        layer="L2",
        source_refs=["message:earlier"],
        status="hypothesis",
    )
    provider.selected = "memory:" + identity
    query = "How should we avoid spilling confidential material?"
    assert router.memory_service.retrieve_context(query)["items"] == []
    result = asyncio.run(router.handle_user_message(query, request_id="semantic"))
    assert result["intent"] == "chat"
    assert len(provider.requests) == 2
    actual = json.loads(provider.requests[-1].messages[1]["content"])
    assert actual["semantic_recall"]["status"] == "selected"
    item = next(item for item in actual["memory"] if item["id"] == identity)
    assert item["status"] == "hypothesis" and item["source_refs"] == ["message:earlier"]


def test_semantic_task_identity_can_reopen_an_older_quest(tmp_path):
    provider = RouterSelector("placeholder")
    store, router = prepared(tmp_path, provider)
    target = Quest(title="Nebula", goal="Construct a safe priority queue")
    store.save_quest(target)
    with store.unit_of_work() as work:
        work.connection.execute("UPDATE quests SET status='completed' WHERE id=?", (target.id,))
    for index in range(3):
        store.save_quest(Quest(title=f"Recent unrelated {index}", goal="Other work"))
    router._sync_memory()
    provider.selected = "quest:" + target.id
    provider.final = decision("continue_quest", quest_id=target.id, candidates=[target.id])
    query = "Resume the starvation resistant scheduling exploration"
    with store.connection() as connection:
        assert target.id not in {row["id"] for row in router._snapshot(connection, query)["quests"]}
    result = asyncio.run(router.handle_user_message(query, request_id="old-semantic"))
    seen = json.loads(provider.requests[-1].messages[1]["content"])
    assert result["intent"] == "continue_quest" and result["quest_id"] == target.id, json.dumps(
        {
            "target": target.id,
            "semantic": seen.get("semantic_recall"),
            "quests": [item["id"] for item in seen.get("quests", [])],
            "memory": [
                {"id": item["id"], "related": item["related_quest_ids"]}
                for item in seen.get("memory", [])
            ],
        }
    )
    assert len(provider.requests) == 2


def test_legacy_router_does_not_add_semantic_provider_call(tmp_path):
    provider = ScriptedMock(decision())
    store = Store(tmp_path / "legacy.sqlite3", workspace=Workspace.from_path(tmp_path))
    router = RouterService(
        store, TeamComposer(ModelRegistry(store)), provider=provider, model_id="mock"
    )
    asyncio.run(router.handle_user_message("hello", request_id="legacy"))
    assert len(provider.requests) == 1


def test_multimodal_task_records_explicit_unavailable_capability_without_planning_event(tmp_path):
    provider = ScriptedMock(
        decision("create_quest", task_kind="multimodal", reply="I will inspect your video")
    )
    store = Store(tmp_path / "multimodal.sqlite3", workspace=Workspace.from_path(tmp_path))
    router = RouterService(
        store, TeamComposer(ModelRegistry(store)), provider=provider, model_id="mock"
    )
    result = asyncio.run(
        router.handle_user_message("Analyze the attached video", request_id="vision")
    )
    quest = store.get_quest(result["quest_id"])
    metadata = json.loads(quest["metadata"])
    assert quest["status"] == "needs_input"
    assert metadata["task_kind"] == "multimodal"
    assert metadata["capability_status"] == "unavailable"
    assert metadata["capability_reason"] == "multimodal_input_protocol_unavailable"
    with store.connection() as connection:
        types = [
            row[0]
            for row in connection.execute(
                "SELECT event_type FROM events WHERE quest_id=?", (quest["id"],)
            )
        ]
    assert "quest.capability_unavailable" in types and "quest.proposed" not in types
    assert "尚未实现" in result["assistant_message"]["content"]
    assert store.list_workers(quest["id"]) == []

"""Phase 2 live Core harness: spawn an isolated Core, authenticate, drive the API.

Credential handling: the provider key is read from a process environment variable
named by FORGE_PROVIDER_CREDENTIAL_REF. Nothing secret is written to disk or logs.
"""

import hashlib
import hmac
import os
import secrets
import socket
import subprocess
import time
from pathlib import Path

import httpx

REPO = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[3]
BACKEND = REPO / "backend"
PYTHON = BACKEND / ".venv" / "Scripts" / "python.exe"

PROVIDER_ID = "wb-local"
MODEL_ID = "deepseek-v4.1-flash"


def free_port():
    with socket.socket() as sock:
        sock.bind(("127.0.0.1", 0))
        return sock.getsockname()[1]


class LiveCore:
    def __init__(
        self, workspace, *, provider_env, token_limit, concurrency, log=None, extra_env=None
    ):
        self.workspace = Path(workspace)
        self.workspace.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        self.port = free_port()
        self.secret = REDACTED
        self.base_url = f"http://127.0.0.1:{self.port}"
        self.session = None
        self.bearer = None
        self.process = None
        self.provider_env = provider_env
        self.token_limit = token_limit
        self.concurrency = concurrency
        self.log_path = log or self.workspace / "core.log"
        self.extra_env = extra_env or {}
        self.stdout = None

    def env(self):
        raw = bytes.fromhex(self.secret)
        assert len(raw) == 32
        values = {
            "FORGE_WORKSPACE_ROOT": str(self.workspace),
            "FORGE_DB_PATH": "data/forge.sqlite3",
            "FORGE_HOST": "127.0.0.1",
            "FORGE_PORT": str(self.port),
            "FORGE_CORE_SECRET": self.secret,
            "FORGE_ROUTER_MODEL_ID": MODEL_ID,
            "FORGE_ROUTER_CONTEXT_LIMIT": "65536",
            "FORGE_ROUTER_OUTPUT_RESERVE": "4096",
            "FORGE_WORKER_LEASE_SECONDS": "150",
            "FORGE_REVIEW_MAX_ROUNDS": "3",
            "FORGE_MODEL_TOKEN_LIMIT": str(self.token_limit),
            "FORGE_MODEL_CONCURRENCY_LIMIT": str(self.concurrency),
            "PYTHONIOENCODING": "utf-8",
            "PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE": "1",
        }
        values.update(self.provider_env)
        values.update(self.extra_env)
        base = {k: v for k, v in os.environ.items() if not k.startswith("FORGE_")}
        base.update(values)
        return base

    def start(self, timeout=120):
        # Kept open for the child lifetime and closed by stop(), including failures.
        self.stdout = open(self.log_path, "ab")  # noqa: SIM115
        env = self.env()
        creation = 0
        if os.name == "nt":
            creation = subprocess.CREATE_NO_WINDOW
        self.process = subprocess.Popen(
            [str(PYTHON), "-m", "forge_api", "--workspace-root", str(self.workspace)],
            cwd=str(BACKEND),
            env=env,
            stdout=self.stdout,
            stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,
            creationflags=creation,
        )
        deadline = time.time() + timeout
        while time.time() < deadline:
            if self.process.poll() is not None:
                raise RuntimeError("Core exited during startup")
            try:
                response = httpx.get(self.base_url + "/health", timeout=2, trust_env=False)
                if response.status_code == 200:
                    self.session = response.json()["session"]
                    raw = bytes.fromhex(self.secret)
                    self.bearer = hmac.new(raw, self.session.encode(), hashlib.sha256).hexdigest()
                    return self
            except (httpx.TransportError, httpx.TimeoutException):
                pass
            time.sleep(0.25)
        raise RuntimeError("Core did not become healthy")

    def client(self, timeout=240):
        return httpx.Client(
            base_url=self.base_url,
            headers={"Authorization": "Bearer " + self.bearer},
            timeout=httpx.Timeout(connect=5, read=timeout, write=10, pool=5),
            trust_env=False,
            follow_redirects=False,
        )

    def call(self, method, path, payload=None, timeout=240):
        with self.client(timeout=timeout) as client:
            response = client.request(method, path, json=payload)
        try:
            body = response.json()
        except ValueError:
            body = {"raw": response.text[:400]}
        return {"status": response.status_code, "body": body}

    def stop(self, *, graceful=True):
        if self.process is None:
            return
        if self.process.poll() is None:
            if graceful:
                self.process.terminate()
            else:
                self.process.kill()
            try:
                self.process.wait(timeout=30)
            except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
                self.process.kill()
                self.process.wait(timeout=15)
        if self.stdout:
            self.stdout.close()
            self.stdout = None

    def tail_log(self, limit=4000):
        if not self.log_path.exists():
            return ""
        data = self.log_path.read_bytes()[-limit:]
        return data.decode("utf-8", "replace")

def _encoded(value):
    return json.dumps(value, ensure_ascii=False, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":"))


def _digest(value):
    return hashlib.sha256(_encoded(value).encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()


def _candidate_refs(memory, cursor, candidate_limit):
    """Read a fixed range per index, without scanning every statement or doing I/O."""
    selectors = (
        ("memory_source_index", "source_ref", ""),
        ("memories", "id", "memory:"),
        ("constraint_records", "id", "constraint:"),
        ("constraint_message_index", "message_id", "message:"),
    )
    with memory._connection() as db:
        tables = {
            row[0]
            for row in db.execute(
                "SELECT name FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='table' AND name IN "
                "('memory_source_index','memories','constraint_records','constraint_message_index')"
            )
        }
        refs = set()
        for table, identifier, prefix in selectors:
            if table not in tables:
                continue
            after = cursor or ""
            if prefix:
                if after.startswith(prefix):
                    after = after[len(prefix) :]
                elif after > prefix:
                    continue
                else:
                    after = ""
            # Identifiers and predicates above are fixed Core literals.
            # Range on the actual primary key, not a concatenation expression;
            # even revoked/stale records count against this page's read bound.
            refs.update(
                prefix + row[0]
                for row in db.execute(
                    f"SELECT {identifier} FROM {table} WHERE {identifier}>? "
                    f"ORDER BY {identifier} LIMIT ?",
                    (after, candidate_limit + 1),
                )
            )
    return sorted(refs)[: candidate_limit + 1]

def _terms(text):
    words = re.findall(r"[a-z0-9_./\\:-]+", text.casefold())
    words.extend(re.findall(r"[a-z0-9_]+", text.casefold()))
    for run in re.findall(r"[\u4e00-\u9fff]+", text):
        words.extend(run[i : i + 2] for i in range(len(run) - 1))
    return sorted(set(words))[:128]


def _index_terms(db, ref, text):
    db.execute("DELETE FROM memory_terms WHERE ref=?", (ref,))
    db.executemany(
        "INSERT OR IGNORE INTO memory_terms VALUES (?,?)", ((word, ref) for word in _terms(text))
    )


def _query_terms(text):
    """Bounded bilingual lexical expansion; this is not embedding retrieval."""
    terms = set(_terms(text))
    lowered = text.casefold()
    for aliases in (
        ("budget", "spending", "预算", "成本", "费用"),
        ("deadline", "due date", "截止", "期限"),
        ("retain", "preserve", "keep", "保留"),
        ("delete", "remove", "删除"),
        ("implementation", "coding", "代码", "实现"),
    ):
        if any(alias in lowered for alias in aliases):
            for alias in aliases:
                terms.update(_terms(alias))
    return sorted(terms)[:128]

    return (
        not kinds

        or ("path" in kinds and item["kind"] == "artifact" and '"path"' in item["statement"])
    )


class MemoryService:

        from .semantic_memory import retrieve_semantic_context

        if connection is not None:

def semantic_wire(graph):
    nodes = []
    for node in graph["nodes"]:
        node = copy.deepcopy(node)
        node.pop("budget_tokens")
        node.setdefault("required_predecessor_deliveries", [])
        node["success_criteria"] = [
            typed_criterion(criterion) for criterion in node["success_criteria"]
        ]
        node["capacity_bounds"].pop("max_source_receipt_bytes")
        nodes.append(node)
    return {"allocation_mode": "core_measured", "nodes": nodes, "edges": graph["edges"]}


def typed_criterion(criterion):

# FORGE v4 — Persistent Router Agent System

FORGE is a self-built, general-purpose autonomous Agent desktop application.

## Engineering status — 2026-11-15

Phase 2 backend acceptance is in progress. The frozen V24 suite recorded
**1,734 passed tests**, with one existing warning in 465.71 seconds; Ruff,
formatting, dependency, whitespace and original-evidence checks passed. All
three strict live runs failed during planning, before any Worker execution.
All 15 model attempts settled (87,044 tokens). The V23 source-prefetch protocol
is implemented, but these failed runs do not establish actual-model completion.
V25 adds explicit model-selected capacity profiles and bounded complete
diagnostics to address repeated infeasible plans within the original caps.
See [ADR-011](docs/adr/ADR-011-approved-declared-source-prefetch.md).
V25 frozen tests and strict live acceptance remain pending.

See the [current status](docs/PHASE2_STATUS.md), [Phase 2 report](docs/PHASE2_AGENT_INTELLIGENCE_REPORT.md),
[experiments](docs/PHASE2_EXPERIMENTS.md) and [V22 historical boundary](docs/audit/phase2/acceptance-independent-v22-boundary.md).
Historical failures and original evidence remain preserved. The real algorithm
microstudy scored 25/90 task successes; it does not establish general policy gains.
Frontend work is being handled separately; packaging is outside this sprint.

Phase 1 Milestones 1–6 provide the persistence, governance, Registry, DAG, native Workers, tool/evidence and context/budget foundation. Historical M6 verification passed 372 tests; one bounded live continuation succeeded after five retained diagnostic failures. The [M7 backend hardening round](docs/PHASE1_MILESTONE7_BACKEND_HARDENING.md) passed 488 local tests. Desktop Alpha, final native integration and packaging are deferred; these historical backend results do not establish a desktop release.

See [current status](docs/STATUS.md), the [Phase 0 audit report](docs/PHASE0_AUDIT.md), and the report's dependency-ordered development plan. The release references `codex/MASTER_PROMPT.md`, but that file is missing from the supplied archive.

**The user has one persistent conversation.** A persistent Router Agent owns that conversation and coordinates multiple long-running Quests and hidden Worker Sessions. Workers have isolated execution contexts, but they are never presented as separate user conversations.

## Product invariants

1. One persistent user-facing conversation per workspace.
2. One persistent Router identity and resumable state per workspace.
3. Multiple durable Quests can run behind that conversation.
4. Worker Sessions are private execution contexts, not user-facing chats.
5. Worker events are selectively relayed into the single conversation timeline.
6. Model Provider, Model Profile, Role Template, Agent Instance, Quest and Session are separate domain entities.
7. Model Registry uses provider metadata, FORGE benchmark results, online performance and explicit user overrides.
8. Team composition combines reusable role templates with bounded dynamic role synthesis.
9. FORGE owns its Agent Loop, Router, Worker Runtime, Tool Engine, Memory, Governance and Evidence.
10. Codex, DSH and Claude Code are architectural references only, never execution backends.

"""Production Composer semantics bound to previously approved Core resources.

This adapter proposes no permissions, changes no plan, and performs no model
selection. TeamCompositionService must still validate the resulting proposal,
remeasure the selected Provider request, and require normal user approval.

from typing import Literal

from pydantic import BaseModel, ConfigDict, Field

from .budget_policy import validate_serial_policy
from .domain import DomainError
from .hierarchical_plans import node_depth
from .team_composition import TeamCapabilityWire, TeamWire


class InvalidTeamProposal(DomainError):
    """Two settled production Composer responses failed deterministic admission."""


def uses_core_composer_resources(graph):
    contract = graph.get("capacity_contract") or {}
    return (
        contract.get("version") == "verified-capacity-v1"
        and (contract.get("resource_allocation") or {}).get("mode") == "core_measured"
        and bool(contract.get("nodes"))
        and all(
            type(item.get("output_bound")) is int and item["output_bound"] > 0
            for item in contract["nodes"].values()
        )
    )


class SemanticTeamRoleWire(BaseModel):
    model_config = ConfigDict(extra="forbid", strict=True)
    id: str = Field(min_length=1, max_length=100)
    task_node_key: str = Field(min_length=1, max_length=100)
    required_capabilities: list[TeamCapabilityWire] = Field(max_length=32)
    tools: list[str] = Field(max_length=32)
    dynamic: bool
    responsibility: str = Field(min_length=1, max_length=2000)
    input_contract: list[str] = Field(max_length=20)
    output_schema_json: str | None = Field(
        description="Explicit null selects the supplied Core strict eight-field delivery schema."
    )
    acceptance_criteria: list[str] = Field(max_length=20)


class SemanticTeamWire(BaseModel):
    model_config = ConfigDict(extra="forbid", strict=True)
    roles: list[SemanticTeamRoleWire] = Field(min_length=1, max_length=16)
    strategy: Literal["single_model", "greedy", "coverage", "complementarity"]

    def inputs(self, graph, *, operator_max_concurrency):
        """Bind exact approved output/baseline; normal service admission follows.

        Source limits remain ceilings. Steps/tools use bounded Core defaults when
        no source limit exists; duration is divided within the approved total.
        The shared serial reserve appears once in the team limit and never in
        role allocations. Execution limits remain the service's responsibility.
        """
        if not uses_core_composer_resources(graph):
            raise DomainError("Core Composer requires approved measured output bounds")
        if type(operator_max_concurrency) is not int or operator_max_concurrency < 1:
            raise DomainError("Core Composer requires an operator concurrency ceiling")
        nodes = {node["key"]: node for node in graph["nodes"]}
        keys = [role.task_node_key for role in self.roles]
        if len(set(keys)) != len(keys) or set(keys) - set(nodes):
            raise DomainError("Each approved task node requires exactly one team member")
        maximum = (graph.get("execution_constraints") or {}).get("limits", {})
        count = len(self.roles)
        if count > min(16, maximum.get("max_members", 16)):
            raise DomainError("Team max_members exceeds source-bound task limit")
        serial = validate_serial_policy(graph)
        concurrency = (
            1
            if serial
            else min(count, operator_max_concurrency, maximum.get("max_concurrency", count))
        )
        duration = min(
            graph.get("max_duration_seconds") or 120 * count,
            maximum.get("max_duration_seconds", 120 * count),
            3600 * count,
        )
        if type(duration) is not int or duration < count:
            raise DomainError("Approved duration cannot fund every team member")
        per_role_duration, extra = divmod(duration, count)
        duration_by_key = {
            key: per_role_duration + (index < extra) for index, key in enumerate(sorted(keys))
        }
        steps = min(32, maximum.get("max_worker_steps", 16))
        calls = min(64, maximum.get("max_worker_tool_calls", 16))
        roles = []
        observations = graph["capacity_contract"]["nodes"]

                    "input_tokens": baseline - output,

                    "max_duration_seconds": duration_by_key[wire.task_node_key],

        )
        if allocation > min(
            graph["max_total_tokens"] - (graph.get("coordination_reserve_tokens") or 0),
            maximum.get("max_total_tokens", graph["max_total_tokens"]),
        ):
            raise DomainError("Core team resources exceed the original approved ceiling")
        tools = sorted({tool for role in self.roles for tool in role.tools})
        limits = {
            "max_members": count,
            "max_depth": max(role["depth"] for role in roles),
            "max_concurrency": concurrency,
            "max_total_tokens": allocation,
            "max_total_tool_calls": sum(role["max_tool_calls"] for role in roles),

format.definition:
start: pragma_source | plain_source
pragma_source: PRAGMA_LINE NEWLINE SOURCE
plain_source: SOURCE

PRAGMA_LINE: /[ \t]*\/\/ @exec:[^\r\n]*/
NEWLINE: /\r?\n/
SOURCE: /[\s\S]+/

tools.name: exec

tools.description:
Waits on a yielded `exec` cell and returns new output or completion.
- Use `wait` only after `exec` returns `Script running with cell ID ...`.
- `cell_id` identifies the running `exec` cell to resume.
- `yield_time_ms` controls how long to wait for more output before yielding again. Defaults to 10000 ms.
- `max_tokens` limits how much new output this wait call returns. Defaults to 10000 tokens.
- `terminate: true` stops the running cell; false or omitted waits for output.
- `wait` returns only the new output since the last yield, or the final completion or termination result for that cell.
- If the cell is still running, `wait` may yield again with the same `cell_id`.
- If the cell has already finished, `wait` returns the completed result and closes the cell.
tools.name: wait

cell_id.description: Identifier of the running exec cell.

max_tokens.description: Output token budget for this wait call. Defaults to 10000 tokens.

terminate.description: True stops the running exec cell; false or omitted waits for output.

yield_time_ms.description: Wait before yielding more output. Defaults to 10000 ms.

tools.description: Request user input for one to three short questions and wait for the response. This tool is only available in Plan mode.
tools.name: request_user_input

questions.description: Questions to show the user. Prefer 1 and do not exceed 3

header.description: Short header label shown in the UI (12 or fewer chars).

options.description: Provide 2-3 mutually exclusive choices. Put the recommended option first and suffix its label with "(Recommended)". Do not include an "Other" option in this list; the client will add a free-form "Other" option automatically.

description.description: One short sentence explaining impact/tradeoff if selected.

question.description: Single-sentence prompt shown to the user.

tools.description: Tools for reading and waiting on time.
tools.name: clock

tools.description: Pause execution for a specified duration. The sleep ends early when new input arrives for the active turn. Returns the elapsed wall-clock time.
tools.name: sleep

duration_ms.description: How long to sleep in milliseconds. Must be between 1 and 43200000.

tools.description: Tools for spawning and managing sub-agents.
tools.name: collaboration

tools.description: Send a follow-up task to an existing non-root target agent and trigger a turn if it is idle. If the target is already running, deliver the task promptly at message boundaries while sampling, or after the pending tool call completes.
tools.name: followup_task

message.description: Message text to send to the target agent.

target.description: Agent id or canonical task name to send a follow-up task to (from spawn_agent).

tools.description: Interrupt an agent's current turn, if any, and return its previous status. The agent remains available for messages and follow-up tasks.
tools.name: interrupt_agent
